aboutGame.title: What is Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police?
paragraphs: Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police is a Roblox emergency aviation simulator from developer Veltsim_Officiel. You fly rotary-wing and fixed-wing aircraft for three service branches: SAMU medical evacuation, Sécurité Civile fire rescue, and Gendarmerie Nationale police air support. Every dispatch drops you into a different job, from winching an injured hiker off a cliff face to dumping water on a spreading wildland blaze.

Pilots start with a free EC145 and earn credits by completing callouts, then reinvest them into faster airframes such as the EC135, AS365 Dauphin and H145. Our wiki covers the whole loop: flight controls and keybindings, hoist rescue procedures, water drop technique, aircraft tiers and costs, mission walkthroughs, and the radio dispatch codes crews use in multiplayer.

faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police.

items.question: What is Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police?
items.answer: Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police is a Roblox emergency aviation simulator from developer Veltsim_Officiel. You fly helicopters and fixed-wing aircraft for three branches - SAMU medical evacuation, fire rescue and Gendarmerie police air support - completing hoist rescues, water drops and surveillance missions to earn credits.

items.question: Is Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police is free to play on Roblox and every pilot starts with a free EC145. Faster airframes such as the EC135, AS365 Dauphin and H145 are unlocked with credits earned on missions.

items.question: How do I stop my helicopter from spinning in Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police?
items.answer: Spinning comes from adding collective faster than you correct torque. In Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police, raise Left Shift in small increments, counter the nose with the Q and E yaw controls, and soften your sensitivity curves so small cyclic inputs stay smooth.

items.question: Are there working codes in Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police?
items.answer: There are no redeem codes in Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police - every aircraft is unlocked with credits earned from missions. The codes page instead covers the radio 10-codes your crew runs, such as 10-8 for in service and 10-33 for emergency traffic.

items.question: Which helicopter should I buy first in Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police?
items.answer: Stay on the free EC145 until hovering and hoisting feel natural, then save roughly 160,000 credits for the EC135. In Rotor Ops Rescue Fire Police the EC135's higher agility and top speed cut response times on urban and canyon callouts.
